name: inkwell
description: macOS system-wide keystroke logger with optional Obsidian vault sync
author: Vincent

scripts.build: export PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.pack: export PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 && tsc && vite build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.reset-permissions: tccutil reset Accessibility com.inkwell.app && tccutil reset ListenEvent com.inkwell.app
scripts.reset-permissions:dev: tccutil reset Accessibility com.github.Electron && tccutil reset ListenEvent com.github.Electron
